subject.title: Feature request: Rotate menu bar display modes periodically

question: Should CodexBar add automatic metric rotation to its core menu-bar UX, and if so should the first version expose full mode and interval customization?
rationale: The request introduces autonomous title changes and new persisted settings; source inspection can identify an implementation seam but cannot decide whether the motion, width changes, and settings complexity fit the intended product experience.

options.title: Sponsor a narrow rotation mode
options.body: Add an opt-in fixed-interval rotation across available percent, pace, and reset-time states, deferring advanced customization until usage validates it.

options.title: Sponsor full customization
options.body: Allow users to select participating modes and an interval from the initial implementation, accepting a larger settings and validation surface.

options.title: Keep manual modes only
options.body: Decline automatic cycling to preserve a stable, predictable menu-bar title and avoid background timing behavior.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a narrow rotation mode
recommendation.body: Add an opt-in fixed-interval rotation across available percent, pace, and reset-time states, deferring advanced customization until usage validates it.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner merged the adjacent display-setting features and is best positioned to decide the intended menu-bar UX boundary.
